description: A bullish fair value gap walks its full wick-based lifecycle: OPEN, TOUCHED, CE_FILLED, then FILLED at the distal edge — without a single close through the zone.
labelling_rationale: SLS §5.4 defines a bullish FVG over three consecutive closed candles c1, c2, c3 as existing when L[c3] > H[c1], with the zone being [H[c1], L[c3]] and Consequent Encroachment stored as the midpoint. Candle 0 highs at 100 and candle 2 lows at 105, so the gap is 5 and the zone is [100, 105] with CE at 102.5, confirmed at the close of candle 2. The registration filter requires the gap to be at least 0.25 x ATR or the middle candle to be a displacement; true ranges for candles 0..2 are 2, 11 and 8, summing to 21 over three candles for an ATR of exactly 7, so the threshold is 1.75 and a gap of 5 clears it on size alone. Displacement itself cannot apply here because §5.10 needs a 20-candle lookback the series does not have, so displacements is 0. The lifecycle then follows §5.4's state ladder, whose critical rule is that a wick through the zone rebalances the inefficiency while only a CLOSE beyond the distal edge inverts polarity. Entry into the zone is judged by overlap of the candle's whole range with the band, not by its high alone: candle 3 spans 104 to 111, so it dips to 104 which is inside [100, 105] but stays above CE at 102.5, giving OPEN -> TOUCHED. Candle 4 wicks to 101, below the midpoint, giving CE_FILLED. Candle 5 wicks to 99, through the distal edge at 100, but closes at 106 well inside the zone — wick-through, so FILLED rather than INVERTED, which is precisely the distinction §5.4 calls critical. FILLED is terminal, so no live zones remain. No further FVG registers at candles 3, 4 or 5 because in each case both the bullish and bearish three-candle gaps are negative. Candle numbers above are scenario-relative; the 294 declared filler candles (SLS §1.9 warm-up) shift them by 294 in the expected output. The filler's high matches the scenario's first candle so the seam cannot form a swing high, and its low sits below so it cannot form a swing low; neither a bullish nor a bearish three-candle gap spans the seam, so declared history registers no zone of its own.
